completedPhaseClaims.claim: Scopes 1 and 2 are implemented and evidenced. Neither is DoD-complete: Scope 1 has 7 unticked DoD items (2 blocked on the missing notes/decision-attention.md, 5 unrun verifications) and Scope 2 has 4 (1 genuine coverage gap on item-naming in refusal messages, 3 unrun verifications). Each unticked item carries an Uncertainty Declaration in its scope.md naming the evidence owed.

Scope 3 is implemented and evidenced. The #decisionAttention tier renders above #attention and #attentionRecord renders below #scorecard, both from committed data with an empty off-origin and provider-bound request set. All 5 browser scenarios are proven RED then GREEN with their exact persistent titles, and TP-03-05 is proven to bite by an adversarial mutation of market-brief.html that was restored byte-identical. Scope 3 is NOT DoD-complete: 14 of 19 DoD items are ticked and 5 are not. Two of the five are genuine coverage gaps rather than unrun commands - the empty and narrow projections have no assertions anywhere, and the no-fifth-view constraint has none - and both need Test Plan rows from bubbles.plan. The other three are unrun verifications (scripts/selftest.mjs, an excluded-path baseline diff, and zero-console-error/warning coverage across all five runs). Each unticked item carries an Uncertainty Declaration in scope.md. Two mid-scope events are narrated in the scope report: a live collision with the 4x/day publication cron that demonstrated the hazard finding F-017-02 predicted, and TP-03-05 having been simultaneously unsatisfiable and tautological until its fixture strings were renamed with both assertions preserved byte-identical. One new defect, F-017-04, was found and filed in the feature-level report.md rather than fixed here.

Artifact-record completion pass. No source, test, config, payload, HTML or notes file was modified and no git mutation was run; every write landed inside specs/017-decision-attention-and-developing-situations/. Scope 5's report.md was written from a session that ran all five guardrails green across the whole repository: selftest 1251 passed / 0 failed exit 0, validate-brief-payload exit 0, rlattention suite 25/0, attention-payload-contract suite 15/0, six browser scenarios passing, and the reader-legibility audit at zero leaks over 23 pages. SCN-017-044 is narrated honestly as BLOCKED for part of delivery on three failures that a clean-HEAD worktree (1230 passed, 3 failed) proved this feature did not introduce - a cron publish had dropped events[].psychologyNote, a key HEAD's own committed validator requires - and it passes now that the payload is repaired. Scopes 4 and 5 moved from 0/22 ticked to 17/22 each. Scopes 1, 2 and 3 were re-swept for items the new evidence unblocks: scope 1 33->37 (rlmarketaction byte-identity, the notes imminence rule, the .only scan, selftest), scope 2 13->14 (selftest), scope 3 14->15 (selftest). NEITHER scope 4 NOR scope 5 IS DoD-COMPLETE and no scope was marked Done. 22 DoD items remain unticked across the five scopes, each carrying an Uncertainty Declaration naming the evidence owed. Three findings were raised rather than ticked around - see nextRequiredTarget.

Artifact-record pass for Scope 6. No source, test, config, payload, HTML or notes file was modified and no git mutation was run; every write landed inside specs/017-decision-attention-and-developing-situations/. Scope 6 moved from Not Started 0/26 to In Progress 19/26 ticked, and is NOT DoD-complete. Four evidence sets were recorded from the executing session: E1 the defect (three consecutive cron publishes 348c9f88, d2f85159, 1412f3e0 each emitting zero decision-attention/v1 markers while enforcement was intact at 3 validateAttentionItem call sites and the gate exited 1); E2 the RED (SCN-017-047, SCN-017-048, SCN-017-049 failing, 25 tests / 22 pass / 3 fail, first failure RLATTN-WINDOW); E3 the GREEN sweep (selftest 1271 passed 0 failed exit 0, rlattention 26/0, attention-payload-contract 25/0, playwright 7 passed, validate-brief-payload PUB_EXIT=0, reader-legibility 23 pages 0 leaks); E4 the adversarial bite (exclusions.push neutralised behind if(false) so refusals drop silently, 6 guards fired including all three required rows TP-06-02/03/04, step restored byte-identical sha256 2d4536522da879b7116ee81e28d5275febe6578b1b0c6e95ebe5025e7d45b3fb). All seven Test Plan rows executed and passed. THE LESSON IS RECORDED IN THE SCOPE REPORT: F-017-02 correctly identified the authoring lane as part of the atomic change, then assumed that updating its instruction would produce compliance; three publishes falsified that. A prose instruction to a language model is advisory, whereas routing the lane through the certified composer makes compliance structural, because the lane can no longer emit a non-conforming envelope when it no longer emits the envelope at all. A PROCESS DEVIATION is recorded rather than hidden: scripts/build-attention-items.mjs was first created by the test-writing agent in breach of its stated boundary, and was subsequently completed and verified under the implement role. The artifact is sound on the recorded evidence; the independence of its RED run is not, because that RED is a RED against code the test author wrote. Seven items are unticked, each with an Uncertainty Declaration - see nextRequiredTarget for the two that need a decision rather than a rerun. Neither the top-level status nor certification.status was written; bubbles.validate owns certification and has not run.
